scope.meaning: Repository-owned brand contract. Consumer adoption and product accessibility are verified independently.

statusDefinitions.selected: Direction selected by the brand owner; changes follow the package release process.
statusDefinitions.working: Concrete current preview value or implementation; available for review and testing.
statusDefinitions.inherited: Retained baseline material with provenance; not newly measured or independently approved here.
statusDefinitions.provisional: Candidate or incomplete cross-context decision; consumers must not treat it as a stable default.
statusDefinitions.unverified: Not established by the reviewed material.
statusDefinitions.requirement: Accessibility requirement summary; see the authoritative criterion and its exceptions.

decisions.summary: Restrained typography-led identity; keep official mark; discard artwork.
Pacific/lavender reserved for link states; primary/action/info roles stay neutral.
Graphite neutrals and coordinated feedback palette are the current contract values.
Tabler replaces Iconoir for this design direction.
Moss & clay is the selected working syntax direction.
Sizing, label, focus and overlay refinements are shared CSS recipes; consuming UI owns markup and behaviour.

rules.text: Quiet, clear and recognisably technical. Recognition comes from typography, proportion, the retained mark and consistent interface details.
Do not add custom ASCII, halftone or bespoke artwork to this direction.
Reserve Pacific for unvisited content links and lavender for visited links. Retain underlines for inline content links. Navigation controls may remain neutral.
Primary actions, selection, focus and informational messages use neutral roles. The shadcn token named accent is a neutral interaction role, not permission to introduce a brand hue.
Success uses green; warning uses amber; error/destructive uses clay-red. Pair state colour with meaningful text or a recognizable indicator. Do not use success colour for ordinary primary actions.
Space Grotesk carries headings, prose, labels and controls. JetBrains Mono carries code, identifiers, versions and occasional short metadata.
Use the pinned Tabler outline family, currentColor and a 2-unit stroke in a 24×24 viewBox. Use filled drawings only for explicitly mapped state icons.
Keep decorative SVG hidden from assistive technology. Put the accessible name on an icon-only control; meaningful standalone icon content needs equivalent text.

Keep glyph size separate from pointer target size. Current recipes use 16px inline, 20px action/status, 24px standalone icons; default controls 40px, compact 32px, small/calendar 36px, large 44px at a 16px root.
Use a visible neutral focus outline. Current recipe is 2px with 3px offset; verify adjacent colours, clipping and obscuration in each composition.
Supply persistent labels, associated hints and explicit error text. Each thumb in a range slider needs its own meaningful name.
Use the inherited 4px spacing basis; choose a token by relationship rather than copying incidental screenshot gaps. The historical 48px cover-pattern purpose is not revived.
Current base radius is 0.25rem. Derived shadcn radius aliases are documented in componentRecipes; historical cut corners and hard offset button shadows are not carried forward.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion. The current preview reduces animation/transition duration and iteration count; each consuming application must preserve useful state changes.
Use Moss & clay for code, retaining distinct syntax roles. Use semantic success/danger plus +/− markers for diffs. Warm graphite and Sage are comparison alternatives, not competing defaults.

limits: No universal 16px minimum is asserted as WCAG.
No mandatory modular ratio is claimed.
The final shared heading scale and renderer typography remain to be consolidated.
Only normal variable font files are bundled, under their retained OFL licences. Italic assets are not included; do not assume a real italic face exists.

icons.filledUsage: Only explicit upstream filled state marks; outline is the default
icons.accessibility: Decorative SVG is aria-hidden; meaning comes from visible text or an accessible control label
icons.assetPolicy: Pinned local drawing data; no runtime CDN, icon font or added runtime icon package

mark.geometrySource: Geometry ratios are inherited from baseline and correspond to the local horizontal SVG; the baseline describes the original square source.
usage: Use the official mark geometry; do not redraw, stretch or create unreviewed variants.
The inspected SVG has a fixed #f0edee fill intended for a dark surface; verify contrast and approved asset variant before placing it on light backgrounds.

authoring: Keep pinned UI components unchanged when CSS or sample composition suffices.
Use semantic tokens rather than literal colours in consuming screens.
Keep keyboard, focus, label and status behavior supplied by primitives intact.
Provide text or another visible cue alongside state colour.
Check overlays, mobile widths, zoom, long labels and error states in consuming applications.

syntax.label: Moss & clay
syntax.scope: Syntax only; does not redefine link or UI feedback roles.

requirements.text: For applicable text, meet 4.5:1; large text may use 3:1. Large means at least 18pt, or 14pt bold, not 18px. WCAG exceptions still apply.
Visual information needed to identify active controls, states and meaningful graphics must meet 3:1 against adjacent colours, subject to criterion exceptions. Decorative lines need not all meet 3:1.
Do not use colour as the only visual means of conveying information, prompting a response or distinguishing an action.

WCAG 2.2 AA target minimum is 24×24 CSS px, with spacing, equivalent-control, inline, user-agent and essential exceptions. Our 40px default is a comfort choice. Glyph bounds do not establish pointer-target bounds.

Support user overrides of line height 1.5×, paragraph spacing 2×, letter spacing 0.12em and word spacing 0.16em without loss, subject to the criterion. These are override tests, not mandatory authored defaults.

accessibility.scopeNote: These design-relevant summaries are not the full WCAG checklist. Keyboard operation, focus, names/roles, zoom/reflow, validation and assistive-technology testing still belong to each integration.
accessibility.evidenceNote: Existing gallery render and icon reports are bounded smoke checks, not certification. This contract contains no newly measured contrast ratios.

consumption.authority: src/contract.json in unset-sh/brand is the editable source. Generated exports are the public interface. The sheet-copy authority is superseded by docs/decisions/0001-contract-and-guide.md.
consumption.references: ref inherits a token; values selects light or dark; value applies to both. Source paths are repository-relative.
consumption.cssNames: cssVariable is the public CSS name. Consumers use semantic or component roles, not primitive palette tokens.
consumption.statusFiltering: Provisional records are working defaults subject to review; do not treat them as a settled brand decision.
consumption.versioning: Exact versions. Breaking role/ID/type/export changes require a major release; intentional visual value/default changes and additive roles a minor; documentation or fixes without changed meaning a patch. Use Changesets. Owner-approved initial exception: 0.1.1 introduces the contract and guide with an incompatible migration from 0.1.0; see docs/decisions/0002-initial-contract-version.md and docs/migration.md.
consumption.query: Import contract.json for metadata, resolved.json for theme-specific resolved values, or run npm run query -- <id-or-prefix> [light|dark].
consumption.generation: npm run build validates and generates dist; npm run check rejects generated drift. No consumer runs this repository build tooling.
consumption.publication: Static npm package on GitHub Packages; Hugo guide and Svelte gallery on GitHub Pages. A published version must be adopted, rebuilt and deployed by each consumer.
consumption.architecture: Primitive values → semantic roles → component bindings. Optional Tailwind/shadcn CSS adapters. UI behaviour and business rules remain outside the package.
